note: Offline gates of the contact support (descent-view declaration version 2, haltere.liftoff.fast_race_cue.ContactSupportConfig), frozen with that declaration after the design and before any gate run: haltere.liftoff.contact_support_eval (rest, surrogate, clean, score) and haltere/obstacles/vertical_replay.py for the replays. Development evidence already seen (disclosed in the declaration's contact_support_development): the rule's code on every logged flight, the resting scenario for the fast PD and fast-brain-10b, the minus-fast6-r4-02 replay and the surrogate on development seeds. CS_Rest, CS_R402 and CS_Clean are therefore not blind; CS_Surrogate (gate seeds, never run with this rule) and CS_Identity are. Nothing here is flight evidence.

baseline_tree.tree: git archive of 3decaac (the round-4 integrated stack; wall pilot v4, descent view v1), replayed with this tree's harness (haltere/obstacles/vertical_replay.py --tree)

pd.note: the fast PD (the checkpoint gives its calibration and camera only)

variants.none: --stack none (the default pilot; Straw laps and pine-brain08-01 with the offline looming stream)
variants.shadow: --stack shadow --near-on-path (every rule of the stack computed and logged, none applied)
variants.stack: --stack on --near-on-path (the obstacle stack as the runner builds it for the flight's motor contract; this tree: wall pilot version 5)
variants.stack_wp4: --stack on --near-on-path --wall-pilot configs/obstacles/wall_pilot_v4.json (this tree with the kept version 4: the round-4 stack as flown)
variants.stack_dv1: --stack on --near-on-path --descent-view configs/pilot/descent_view_v1.json (baseline tree: its descent_view.json, version 1)
variants.stack_dv2_cthr_wp4: --stack on --near-on-path --descent-view configs/pilot/descent_view.json --throttle-column command_thr --wall-pilot configs/obstacles/wall_pilot_v4.json (the round-4 stack as flown with descent view version 2; the pilot's issued throttle is the motor's command, as in the runner)
variants.stack_dv2_cthr: --stack on --near-on-path --descent-view configs/pilot/descent_view.json --throttle-column command_thr (the round-4b stack: wall pilot 5, descent view 2; report)

CS_Identity.definition: default behaviour with the new rules off is bit-identical to m4: for every flight, this tree's replay equals the baseline tree's on the command keys (vertical_replay.COMMAND_KEYS) for --stack none, --stack shadow, --stack on with the kept wall pilot version 4 (baseline: its own version 4) and --stack on with the kept descent view version 1 and wall pilot version 4 (baseline: its own versions)

CS_Rest.definition: the round-4 review's resting case (scratchpad m4/review/scenarios.py) with the motor that would fly: contact_support_eval.resting_scenario: level free flight at (speed, 0, 0) with the ring ahead for prologue_s, then resting on a surface (measured velocity held, vz 0) with the ring clipped at the bottom edge for rest_s, the pilot with descent view version 2; the first support-climb onset after the rest begins
CS_Rest.pass_rule: every (motor, speed): a support climb within max_delay_s of the rest; none in the prologue

CS_R402.definition: minus-fast6-r4-02 replayed through the round-4 stack as flown with descent view version 2 (variant stack_dv2_cthr_wp4): a contact-rule onset (contact_fire) during the garage-floor contact, log phase within window (z < 0.1 m for 1.5 s)
CS_R402.pass_rule: at least one contact-rule onset in the window

CS_Surrogate.definition: the round-4 surrogate (descent_rehearsal.run_batch: IdentifiedSim, 10% per-drone randomisation, HUD marker latency and dropout, three-tick command delay) on the gate course sets, the intended deployed pilot (variant full: --obstacle-stack on as the runner builds it for the motor contract, wall pilot version 5, + --descent-view on, version 2). The surrogate has no ground reaction (its hills are scoring-only), so every contact-rule onset is a false support; with none, every course must equal the round-4 'full' run (m4 tree: wall pilot 4, descent view 1; stored in reference_dir) on compare_keys
CS_Surrogate.pass_rule: 0 contact-rule onsets on every course; every course identical to its reference on compare_keys

CS_Clean.definition: the rule's code on every logged flight with at least min_frames rows (contact_support_eval.detector_on_log: the recorded motion and attitude, the logged velocity command and issued throttle command_thr of the previous tick): an onset counts as a false support when it lies outside every contact the frozen contact audit (configs/contact_audit.json version 1) reports for that log, widened by margin_s, and outside the last terminal_s of a run that ended on an impact
CS_Clean.pass_rule: no onset outside the audit contacts

reports.floor_scenario: contact_support_eval.floor_scenario (nominal surrogate with a flat floor) for the four motors
reports.full_stack: variant stack_dv2_cthr on every flight: contact-rule onsets and brake sink withheld (the round-4b stack as it would fly)
reports.straw_contacts: the rule on the ten labelled Straw Bale downhill contacts (straw-brain08-04/-06)
